The '''Imperial Outpost 5440''' was a military garrison of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]], located between the abandoned East and South Refineries.<ref name="ActionTidings2" /> During Imperial reign, [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmers]] were housed on the base.<ref name="ActionTidings5">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041028bespin5|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 5: An Exclusive!}}</ref> After the Imperials were driven off from [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], the base was converted for housing, businesses, and a [[HoloNet relay/Legends|HoloNet relay]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
